review_kind: Phase 0 independent design skeptic, candidate ADR-0148 v3

reviewer.model: Claude Sonnet (fresh, independent; did not review v1 or v2)

findings.claim: The ascending-scan idempotence is racy. Orchestrator A produces attempt 0 then STALLS (slow, not crashed). A supervisor starts B; B's scan sees attempt 0 at PRODUCED, rule 4 says skip unconditionally, so B publishes attempt 1. A resumes and publishes attempt 0. Two PUBLISHED roots for one intent, at different stream_ids, so no per-stream check compares them.
findings.author_verification: ACCEPTED. The read-then-act scan is the entire safety mechanism and _lifecycle_transition's lock wraps one call, never the scan-then-produce sequence. Grep of the ADR confirms no lease/fencing/single-writer language anywhere in DP1.
findings.consequence: the exact defect the whole v1-v3 lineage exists to close recurs under an ordinary non-adversarial failure (slow worker + premature retry)
findings.family: concurrency gap masquerading as a closed invariant

findings.claim: derivation_head cannot be both 'read-only, writing nothing' and correct. A true peek reports 'no stream' for an attempt that IS published in the durable store after a restart -- the one scenario the durability claim is about. Calling _reload_stream to be correct mutates _streams/_receipt_len and can raise.
findings.author_verification: ACCEPTED; _reload_stream (1720-1741) mutates at 1739 and raises on WORM violations.

findings.claim: The attempt ceiling has no value, no owner, and no exhaustion remedy. If attempts 0..N-1 all stall at PRODUCED/SEALED under a recurring fault, the intent is permanently unproducible -- the same 'bricked' class v2's C-1 raised, moved from one stream to one intent.
findings.family: unspecified load-bearing constant (CLAUDE.md: never hardcode what could change)

findings.claim: DP6's two-input writer signature does not cover prior_envelope_sha256, the 15th envelope field. 14 of 15 resolve from (a) the v2 member and (b) the roster policy; the 15th is attributed to a third source ('derived by the hop from events it has already projected'), requiring cross-call state or an unnamed chain-resolution algorithm whose ordering is not obviously the stated canonical order.
findings.author_verification: ACCEPTED; the ADR names no chain-resolution mechanism.
findings.family: restated constraint that excludes the hardest field

findings.claim: Scoping durability to development-broker only was not propagated to 'The three hops, in order', where hop 2 is 'a distinct, later consumer document' -- naturally a separate process. Whether the three-hop sequence is itself in or out of that concession is left open.

CapturedDerivationHop's orchestration loop has no named owner module, while DP2 does name one for hop 3. The loop must call BOTH trust.py (pipeline) and bundles.py (production) in one routine, so it cannot live in dskit/pipeline (purity gate). With no textual anchor and DP7 already adding child code, a generic mechanism could land in the child.
findings.author_verification: ACCEPTED; owner is almost certainly dskit/production per the purity asymmetry.
findings.family: unowned mechanism (v1 M4's family, recurring one layer up)

findings.claim: line drift: replay subject at trust.py:5040 not 5039; _REPLAY_TAPE_INPUTS at document.py:765 not 766. Content matches exactly.

reviewer_error_recorded.finding: The reviewer marked DP4 (bundles.py importing the trust-side shape table) CLEAN, citing tests/production/test_purity.py's package-wide permission and the reverse-arrow test at line 251.
reviewer_error_recorded.author_correction: That is wrong, and the author verified it directly rather than deferring. test_purity.py has THREE distinct tests: line 148 package-wide (permits dskit.pipeline at any depth), line 251 reverse arrow (pipeline must never import production), and line 170 test_bundles_module_never_imports_pipeline_trust -- a DEDICATED, stricter prohibition on bundles.py specifically, whose own docstring says 'Stricter than the package-wide rule above, which PERMITS but does not REQUIRE this'. The reviewer checked 148 and 251 and missed 170.
reviewer_error_recorded.consequence: Author finding A-1 (evidence 0200) stands. DP4 as written in v3 would require deleting a passing, ADR-0146-sanctioned regression test.
reviewer_error_recorded.process_note: Recorded so the disagreement and its resolution are retrievable; the reviewer's other verifications were sound and several were independently valuable.
